## What this region is

How gloss reaches agents and users: the harness-neutral Read/Grep context, the Claude Code hook adapter and its settings merge, installing.gloss/ and the CLAUDE.md block, and the bin that dispatches every command.

## What it exists for

- Give an agent the gloss context for what it just read or searched
- Answer a Claude Code PostToolUse hook with gloss context
- Get the gloss hooks into a repo's .claude/settings.json
- Keep the hook from bothering the agent or breaking shared settings
- Install or inspect the gloss CLAUDE.md block and .gloss/
- Repo wiring setup deliberately does not do
- Run a gloss command

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- change the wording of the comment rule agents follow → comment-rule-and-source-scanning
- run harvest at pre-commit through lefthook → sidecar-harvest-and-check
- show how stale a file's margin notes are when printing it → read-and-staleness
- check whether agents actually follow the CLAUDE.md snippet → behavioural-evals
- make CI fail when a dagger has no matching section → sidecar-harvest-and-check
